title: Docusaurus docs front matter v3.10
description: Front matter accepted by @docusaurus/plugin-content-docs as of Docusaurus 3.10. Docusaurus marks no field as required, so this is a format check, not a presence check: it constrains the shape of every field the plugin documents and requires none of them. Unknown keys are tolerated, matching Docusaurus, which allows theme and plugin front matter. It claims none of the keys the editorial vocabularies use, so it composes with google:okf:0.1, diataxis:diataxis:1.0, tgdp:templates:1.0, or passo-uno:seven-action:1.0. Pair it with docusaurus:blog:3.10 and docusaurus:pages:3.10 via per-directory config overrides. See https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/plugins/@docusaurus/plugin-content-docs#markdown-front-matter

id.description: Unique document id. Defaults to the file path without the extension.

title.description: Text title used for page metadata. Defaults to the Markdown title, then the id. May be empty.

pagination_label.description: Text shown in the next/previous buttons for this document. Defaults to `sidebar_label`, then `title`.

sidebar_label.description: Text shown for this document in the sidebar. Defaults to `title`.

sidebar_position.description: Position of this document in an autogenerated sidebar. A number, so quoting it makes it a string and Docusaurus rejects it.

sidebar_class_name.description: Class name applied to this document's sidebar label.

sidebar_key.description: Stable identifier for the sidebar item, used mainly for i18n.

sidebar_custom_props.description: Arbitrary custom properties attached to this document's sidebar item.

displayed_sidebar.description: Name of the sidebar to display when viewing this document, overriding the one it belongs to.

hide_title.description: Hide the front matter title at the top of the page. Does not hide a Markdown `#` title.

hide_table_of_contents.description: Hide the right-hand table of contents.

toc_min_heading_level.description: Shallowest heading level shown in the table of contents. Between 2 and 6, and no deeper than `toc_max_heading_level`. Typed `number` rather than `integer` because upstream is `Joi.number().min(2).max(6)` with no `.integer()`; being stricter here would fail a page Docusaurus builds.

toc_max_heading_level.description: Deepest heading level shown in the table of contents. Between 2 and 6. Typed `number` rather than `integer` to match upstream, as with `toc_min_heading_level`.

pagination_next.description: Id of the document the "Next" link points to. `null` removes the link.

pagination_prev.description: Id of the document the "Previous" link points to. `null` removes the link.

parse_number_prefixes.description: Whether the number-prefix parser applies to this document, overriding the plugin's `numberPrefixParser` option.

custom_edit_url.description: URL of this document's edit page. `null` removes the edit link; a relative path is legal.

keywords.description: Keywords meta tag for search engines.

description.description: Meta description for search engines. Defaults to the first line of Markdown content. May be empty.

image.description: Cover image used in social link previews. A site-root path such as `/img/card.png` is legal.

slug.description: Custom URL for this document. Defaults to the file path.

tags.description: Tags for this document: either a string, or an object carrying both a `label` and a `permalink`. `required` and `properties` bind only to the object form, so a plain string tag passes and a half-written object reports the key it is missing.

draft.description: A draft document is available in development only. Cannot be combined with `unlisted`.

unlisted.description: An unlisted document is published but hidden from navigation, search, and sitemaps. Cannot be combined with `draft`.

last_update.description: Overrides the computed last-update information. Takes `author`, `date`, or both, and at least one of them.
